segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 内存与存储空间 with a teammate. I use memory to talk about 内存，程序运行时临时使用的快速空间. I use RAM to talk about 随机存取存储器，电脑主要的运行内存. I use storage to talk about 存储空间，长期保存文件和数据的空间. I tell my teammate: Today I use memory, RAM, and storage. At the end, I say: I can use memory clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 内存与存储空间 with a teammate. I use disk space to talk about 磁盘空间，硬盘或固态硬盘的可用容量. I use save to disk to talk about 保存到磁盘，把数据长期写入存储设备. I use free up space to talk about 释放空间，删除或移动文件以增加可用容量. I tell my teammate: Today I use disk space, save to disk, and free up space. At the end, I say: I can use disk space clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 电话和视频通话 with a teammate. I use Can you hear me? to talk about 你能听见我吗？. I use Your voice is breaking up. to talk about 你的声音断断续续。. I use The connection is unstable. to talk about 连接不稳定。. I tell my teammate: Today I use Can you hear me?, Your voice is breaking up., and The connection is unstable.. At the end, I say: I can use Can you hear me? clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 电话和视频通话 with a teammate. I use Could you turn on your camera? to talk about 你可以打开摄像头吗？. I use You're on mute. to talk about 你静音了。. I use I'll call you back. to talk about 我会给你回电话。. I tell my teammate: Today I use Could you turn on your camera?, You're on mute., and I'll call you back.. At the end, I say: I can use Could you turn on your camera? clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 代码评审 with a teammate. I use code review to talk about 代码评审，由他人检查代码质量和风险. I use review comment to talk about 评审评论，针对代码提出的意见. I use approve changes to talk about 批准改动，表示评审者同意合并. I tell my teammate: Today I use code review, review comment, and approve changes. At the end, I say: I can use code review clearly today.

At the end, I say: I can use code review clearly today.
segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“代码评审”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。code review：代码评审，由他人检查代码质量和风险。示例：Our team uses "code review" to keep the project clear.review comment：评审评论，针对代码提出的意见。示例：Our team uses "review comment" to keep the project clear.approve changes：批准改动，表示评审者同意合并。示例：Our team uses "approve changes" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 代码评审 with a teammate. I use request changes to talk about 要求修改，表示合并前仍需调整. I use leave a comment to talk about 留下评论，对代码或讨论发表意见. I use resolve a conversation to talk about 解决对话，标记某条评审讨论已处理. I tell my teammate: Today I use request changes, leave a comment, and resolve a conversation. At the end, I say: I can use request changes clearly today.
